Name: Add a custom tip percentage
Description:
As a diner I want to type my own tip percentage when 10/15/20% do not fit.

Acceptance criteria:
- A "Custom" option next to the presets opens a number input for the tip percentage.
- Values from 0 to 100 are accepted; anything else shows "Tip must be between 0 and 100%" and totals do not change.
- Choosing a preset again hides the custom input.
- Unit test for any new rule in lib/; Playwright test in e2e/ for the custom flow.

Name: Round the per-person amount up
Description:
As the person paying I want the per-person amount rounded up to the next whole dollar, so nobody has to deal with coins.

Acceptance criteria:
- A "Round up per person" checkbox, off by default.
- When on, per person = ceil(total / people) to the next whole dollar, and the total shown is per person x people (the extra goes to the tip).
- Example: bill 10, tip 10%, 3 people -> per person $4.00, total $12.00, tip $2.00.
- Pure function in lib/tip.ts with unit tests; e2e test for the checkbox.

Name: Remember the last tip choice
Description:
As a returning user I want the tip percentage I used last time to be selected when I open the app again.

Acceptance criteria:
- The selected tip percentage (preset or custom) is saved in localStorage under "tip-splitter:tip".
- On load, a saved valid value is selected; an invalid or missing value falls back to 15%.
- localStorage errors (private mode) never break the page.
- Unit test for parsing the saved value; e2e test that reloads the page and sees the choice kept.

Name: Show the split as a shareable summary
Description:
As the organiser I want to copy a short text summary to paste into a group chat.

Acceptance criteria:
- A "Copy summary" button below the result, enabled only when the bill is valid.
- The copied text is: "Bill $X + tip $Y (Z%) = $T. Each of N pays $P." with values formatted as currency.
- After copying, the button reads "Copied" for 2 seconds.
- Summary text built by a pure function in lib/ with unit tests; e2e test checks the button state.

Name: Support euro and pound
Description:
As a traveller I want to choose the currency so amounts display correctly.

Acceptance criteria:
- A currency select with USD (default), EUR and GBP.
- All amounts use Intl.NumberFormat for the chosen currency (en-US for USD, de-DE for EUR, en-GB for GBP).
- The choice does not change any calculation, only formatting.
- Unit test for the formatter mapping; e2e test switching to EUR shows "115,00" style output.
